updates.title: CVE-2026-62916: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft Entra ID allows unauthorized attackers to elevate privileges over a network. This critical flaw affects identity infrastructure and requires immediate patching to prevent unauthorized access and privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-83941: Entra ID Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A missing authorization flaw in Entra ID permits authorized attackers to escalate privileges across the network. Admins should apply available security updates to close this authorization gap in identity management.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69524: Active Directory Domain Services Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: A use-after-free vulnerability in Active Directory Domain Services enables unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. This critical flaw in on-premises identity infrastructure requires urgent patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69359: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow in Active Directory Domain Services allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges locally on domain controllers. Organizations should prioritize patching this flaw affecting on-premises identity infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Integration with Entra Global Secure Access for Network-Layer File Filtering
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is expanding to filter sensitive files at the network layer through integration with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access. This enhancement enables organizations to block sensitive data from being shared with untrusted cloud apps, generative AI platforms, and content-sharing services at the network perimeter.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Priority Cleanup Workflow with New Security Role
updates.summary: A new security role and multi-approver workflow are being introduced to allow admins to create controlled exceptions for deleting items under retention policies and legal holds on Exchange. This feature provides enterprise-grade compliance auditing and approval controls for retention policy bypass scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: DLP policies are expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling unified data protection across Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions and Cowork. Admins can now prevent labeled knowledge sources from being used in AI interactions and block sensitive information types from being sent to external services like Bing.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management Connector - Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Microsoft Rights Management connector is transitioning from shared-secret to certificate-based authentication, improving security posture. Admins will configure their own Entra app registrations and certificates using new PowerShell cmdlets to handle certificate import, registry configuration, and validation.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard allows admins to monitor device health status across their estate to ensure readiness for policy updates and quickly identify devices unable to receive DLP policies. This operational visibility helps maintain consistent endpoint protection deployment.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard provides out-of-box SLA metrics (MTTA, MTTD, MTTR) for DLP alerts with customizable thresholds for severity levels. Admins gain visibility into operational performance trends and can identify the most frequently exposed sensitive information types.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability, Policy Management, and Reporting Enhancements
updates.summary: Purview is improving auto-labeling capabilities to support larger SharePoint scopes and provide enhanced policy management flexibility. Richer reporting visibility into auto-labeling activity helps organizations validate and manage labeling policies at enterprise scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - File Labeler and File Viewer for macOS
updates.summary: The Information Protection File Labeler and Viewer applications are expanding to macOS, bringing near-feature parity with Windows clients. Advanced label-based protection features will be available on macOS, improving compliance tooling across platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Azure PST Import
updates.summary: Azure PST Import enables administrators to import PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using standard migration service patterns. This feature streamlines large-scale data migrations with analysis and validation phases before final import.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Archive Expansion Beyond 1.5TB
updates.summary: Auto-expanding archive mailboxes can now grow beyond the previous 1.5TB limit, removing operational constraints for E5-licensed customers. This enhancement ensures uninterrupted retention and scalable archive growth as organizations manage growing data volumes.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Label Auto-Labeling for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now extend to non-Microsoft connected applications like Box and Google Workspace, leveraging existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. Organizations can now apply consistent classification and protection across hybrid cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies can now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications such as Box and Google Workspace through Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extension enables organizations to enforce consistent data protection policies across their entire cloud application portfolio.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels - Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Before enforcement, admins can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode to review match results and source distribution without making actual label changes. A new Insights tab provides at-a-glance policy performance visibility, helping admins validate policies before production deployment.
